  agent's reason (untrusted, not part of the approval): ""

data.note: Lane sw-sesslife, P-swarm push: Stop/SessionEnd/PreCompact hooks record in-flight state; dead session closed as interrupted; summary offered to the next session. [operator approval Qb11391fb2a by policy:claim_unavailable via policy]
claim forced past phase deps; held for operator

data.body:
Install PreCompact, Stop and SessionEnd hooks (where the harness has them): write the in-flight state (items held, last gate, a one-line 'next step') as a session note. A session with no end whose lease lapsed is closed 'interrupted' by the next SessionStart (adopt-orphans runs then, not by hand); the next session is shown the previous one's last prompt and note.

DESIGN NOTE 2026-11-05 (lane sw-sesslife; nothing implemented, branch empty, claim released because it was forced past the phase block; design not reviewed or tested).

MEASURED: on this repo's log, read_all + fold of 139,120 events took 3.03 s + 0.71 s = about 3.7 s; a no-op `hooks run stop --dry-run` took 0.85 s. 202 sessions, 160 open; a rough probe (open session whose agent has a lapsed lease and no live one) matched 6, so most open sessions would stay open under the body's rule.

CLAUDE CODE FACTS (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md): SessionEnd hooks have a 1.5 s default budget; a per-hook `timeout` raises it, up to 60 s; its `reason` is clear, resume, logout, prompt_input_exit or other. Stop fires after every main-agent turn, not on a user interrupt. Command hooks accept `async: true`, and `timeout` is not enforced on a running async hook.

CONCLUSIONS: (1) the 3.7 s fold cannot fit the 1.5 s budget, so the SessionEnd entry needs its own `timeout` (planned 30 s); (2) Stop should be `async: true` so a fold does not delay each turn, and its note must be deduped against the session's last in-flight note, else the committed log gets one note per turn. If SessionEnd is killed, the Stop note survives and the interrupted close covers it. `claudehooks.install` must learn entry options (HookSpec timeout/background), including on refresh.

HOOKS: add claude stop and session-end rows, gemini pre-compact and session-end rows, and stop/session_end to hookwriters.INSTALLED; replace _on_nothing for stop and session_end. PreCompact adds in-flight state to the existing compaction note through the `held` strings, not a second note (B-am-handoff). Note shape: `holding B-x (last gate critic passed, next gate ci)`; `holding nothing` only when an earlier note said otherwise.

CLOSE: keep kind session.ended, adding data how=interrupted, reason, last_active (additive, older ddflow reads it as ended); add `reason` to core/redact/log.py. Dead = open, not the current session, agent holds no live lease, a lapse of that agent's lease at or after session start, and no session activity after the lapse. Lapses come from state and from lease.expired events, since a reclaim replaces the lease in state. Cap closes per pass with a knob. Run adopt-orphans first, at SessionStart; dry_run writes nothing.

AVOID services/lanes/ledger.py (under impl-watchdog's lease): the fold sets ended_at from last_active, so the ledger's existing `ended_at >= renewed_at` test keeps reporting an unknown stop when the session went quiet before the last heartbeat, with no ledger edit.

REOPEN: a hook-captured prompt on an ended session appends session.started with resumed=true; the fold, open_sessions and session_view honour it.

NEXT SESSION: show the agent's latest closed session's last prompt and note, fenced with provenance.fence, bounded by a knob, skipped on source=compact.

GLOBS: the recorded lease globs were widened to the files above; `ddflow/services/sessions.py` is now a package. New knobs use per-knob files under templates/upgrade/unreleased/, not changes.toml. `.claude/settings.json` was left for the operator (`ddflow hooks install --claude`).
